name: Knightbane
description:
About This Game

RECLAIM THE FALLEN LANDS

Destroy the enemy, relight the candles and cleanse the banners!

12 minutes is all you have until the final boss.

But beware, knight. Every point of thy VANITY stat emboldens the enemy and will hurry along the appearence of bosses, including the final boss.

Annihilate obstacles

  • Break apart terrain to escape danger

  • Extract gold from walls

  • Shape the battlefield to funnel enemies into traps

Fear not, every death is a minor setback.

New abilities and items will be discovered along the way.

OBTAIN GODLY ABILITIES

Survivor-like Passive abilities

Action roguelite Active abilities

Leveling up will give you the option of ASCENDING your abilities, doing so will not just empower them it will alter them

  • Thy mace will erupt craters

  • Thy projectiles will crackle lightning

  • Thy blade will swing repeatably

LOOT

Numerous items have been left behind by the once great order. Break their containers and claim them!

Some items alter abilities, change damage to fire, clone the entire ability or erupt frost nova on use

3 items types:

  • Items are collected throughout the run in five rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary.

  • Vestiges are run altering starter items. Some may grant you fire damage upon lighting candles, others may grant fortune and some still will stir the enemies making runs harder.

  • Relics are freed from the curse itself and can be claimed only once. One strips every Common item from your pool for the rest of the run. Another turns gold into raw power.
short_desc: Survive 12 minutes. Then the final boss arrives. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.
